title: Fishing Metric0 Monthly Rollup
dataSources: Fishing catches (`fishing:catch`), fishfinder sonar (`fishfinder:reading`), foraging finds (`foraging:find`), game-cam triggers (`gamecam:trigger`).
app: Outdoor logs — fishing apps (Fishbrain), sonar / fishfinder exports, game/trail cameras, and foraging journals — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=fishing:metric0
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats count as events, sum(value) as total_value by _time
| sort _time
description: Summarises monthly event volume and total value for fishing metric0 data.
value: Monthly rollups smooth daily noise and show seasonal shifts in personal activity.
implementation: Aggregate fishing metric0 events monthly and chart count plus total value.
visualization: Column chart of monthly events with total value overlay.
grandmaExplanation: It notices how your fishing metric0 activity added up each month instead of day by day.
